author: Yffe
content: Land the recovered req-bounded var*var overflow discharge in thermite-lower. HOSTILE REVIEW of the unaudited code found three defects: (1) a THERMITE_NO_MUL_AID env backdoor in the codegen path (R-CODE-5 determinism violation) — removed; (2) in-loop products got an INERT body-start aid (a body-start fact does not flow past a Verus loop head) — fixed by placing each aid at its enclosing block's start (fn body via render_mul_proof_block in lower_fn_body, loop body via the same in lower_loop, walker no longer descends into nested loops); (3) no shadowing guard — added block_rebinds so a product over a mutated/shadowed local is skipped. Soundness: assert ... by(nonlinear_arith) requires <exactly the req conjuncts>; can only fail, never prove false; non-param/unbounded operands are skipped so the honest obligation stands (R-DEFER-9). Validated live against verus: sq->L3, a*b*c->L3, in-loop n*n->L3, unbounded n*m->honest fail, mutated acc*n->honest fail, lo+(hi-lo)/2 non-mul->no aid. New tests: thermite-lower/tests/req_bounded_mul_aid.rs (6), forge/tests/req_bounded_mul_conformance.rs (2 live). No golden touched.
